title: Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African stew made with chicken, garlic, and spices, typically cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large clay or ceramic pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tagine spice mix and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and water, and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
